Folks — forwarding Cloudware's request. I'm drafting the narrative and a diagram but want to make sure the following points are accurate before I send anything:
- Control plane separation: For Dedicated we expose per-tenant control plane endpoints that are logically separated; admin plane and telemetry are routed over a private WAN and are accessible only from our control-plane subnets. For Private (VPC) the customer owns the control plane network.
- Data plane: inference GPUs are in tenant-tagged pools. We use tenant overlay + namespace isolation + process-level enforcement on the runtime. Can we call out KV cache scoping and per-tenant GPU allocation?
- Egress: outbound to customer endpoints (for callbacks/webhooks) uses NAT gateways per-tenant or per-VPC. For hosted telemetry/metrics we push over an authenticated TLS channel to our telemetry collector; logs are stored in a customer-tagged bucket with SSE-KMS.

Karthik — can you review the diagram and add a short note about quantization/accelerator pooling (we may want to say "accelerator pools are logically fenced; no cross-tenant process access").

Quick notes (excerpt from the narrative):
- Tenant fencing: Dedicated deployments use network overlays and namespace isolation combined with per-tenant GPU pools. The runtime enforces per-tenant KV cache scoping and process isolation to prevent data leakage across tenants.
- Control plane: For Dedicated, Redwood operates the control plane but logical separation is enforced via service-level ACLs and mTLS; for Private, the customer controls the VPC and the control plane can be self-hosted with the same runtime components.
- Egress: Outbound traffic is NATed through tenant-specific gateways; for regulated deployments we offer an optional outbound proxy that enforces HTTP allow-lists and records headers.
- Evidence: audit logs are retained per customer in a KMS-encrypted store; telemetry is segregated by tenant and available via time-limited exports to auditors under NDA.

Attachments are inlined here and also uploaded to a secure drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AbCdEfG-cloudware-evidence (I can share the unredacted set under NDA if your auditors require it).
